name: Bard - the Performer (touches the Veil lightly)

system.story: Art as power: the troubadour, media-face, or street-legend who moves crowds.

description.value:
Origin: Bard. The heart and the showstopper - best where emotion and spectacle rule.

Resonant Performance

Your performances (music, oratory, media presence) inspire allies and sway crowds (edges to Performance and to mass/crowd influence). Uniquely, a thin half-caster lane through the Veil: certain performances carry a faint arcane charge (a rallying song that steels the soul, a dirge that unnerves a spirit), tapping a light set of Veil-flavored effects.

Chrome caution

The magic-erosion rule applies to a Bard - heavy chrome dulls the arcane edge, exactly as it dulls a caster. Guard Body Integrity like a caster.

Bonus skill & contact

Performance skill; contact: a promoter, journalist, or scene-fixer.
